title: design and construction of 16 new residential houses for Tandridge District Council  - AWARD
description: Tandridge District Council require a contractor for the design and build of 16 new residential houses in the Surrey area.  The scope of works under this ITT comprises the demolition of existing disused sea cadets buildings and the design and construction of 16no. new residential houses with associated facilitating, parking and landscaping works at the former Sea Cadets Centre, Hawarden Road, Caterham, CR3 5QT. It should be noted that additional parking works at another Tandridge District Council owned site is included as part of this Contract as depicted in the Tender drawings. These works are along the branch of Hawarden Road to the rear of Newlands Court, Coulsdon Road, Caterham CR3 5NZ. The Contractor's attention is also drawn to the fact that the Scheme is part funded by the Government initiative Brownfield Land Release Fund (BLRF). Therefore, particular timescales must be met for entering into contract and commencing the BLRF works.

title: MVDC RBC Stray Dog Collection Service - AWARD
description:
Mole Valley District Council and Runnymede Borough Council invites tenders for the provision of stray dog collection services as set out in these documents. 
      
      The Commencement Date for the delivery of the ​services​ is scheduled to be on 27th May 2025 for Mole Valley District Council and 1st April 2025 for Runnymede Borough Council (both at 00:00 hours).  Each Council will be awarding their own Contract for the provision of all services detailed within their own Specification. 
      
      For Mole Valley District Council, the Contract will be awarded for a time period until 31st March 2028, with an option to extend for a further 2-year period (made up of 2 individual 12 month periods) subject to performance and the absolute discretion of the Council.  Mole Valley District Council has an inter-authority agreement in place with Tandridge District Council. The services provided as part of this contract will service both Tandridge and Mole Valley District Council areas. 
       
      For Runnymede Borough Council, the Contract will be awarded for a period of 3 years until 31st March 2028, with an option to extend for a further 2-year period (made up of 2 individual 12 month periods) subject to performance and the absolute discretion of the Council.   
      
      The tender is split into three lots - Lot 1: Mole Valley and Tandridge District Councils - Lot 2: Runnymede Borough Council - Lot 3: All Councils. Tenderers can bid on lots 1, 2 or 3. The purpose of lot 3 is to investigate if there is any efficiencies for the councils sharing one provider and therefore if you are bidding for this lot, the expectation is that your bid will reflect this.

title: TDC AW Croydon Rd Caterham - Improvements - Revised - AWARD
description:
Following a pre-selection stage of a two stage Restricted process (with a value below the FTS threshold for Works) shortlisted suppliers are invited to respond to this revised ITT with amended dates.
      
      Tandridge District Council (The Council) is contracting for highway and public realm improvement works on Croydon Road in Caterham Valley town centre.  Our aim is to create a more pleasant environment in which to spend time (thereby encouraging economic growth and wellbeing), and to mitigate against surface water flooding. The stretch of road to be improved is from the roundabout at the intersection of Croydon Road with Station Avenue and Godstone Road, to the intersection with Colin Road with Croydon Road.  The work area is shown in the attached documents. 
      
      The improvements will include:
      o Upgrading the footways with new paving and, in some areas, wider pavements
      o Replacement hard surfacing for the parking areas including permeable paving 
      o Hydro-rock base for surface water storage/flow control
      o Removal of unnecessary street clutter 
      o Planting of trees and plants
      o Creation of pocket parks/parklets 
      o Creation of rain gardens 
      o Creation of space for caf? seating 
      o Provision of public seating 
      o Provision of cycle parking

title: TDC RL Insurance - Leasehold Properties 2024 - AWARD
description:
Tandridge District Council invites bids for the provision of its property insurance in respect of private dwellings sold on a leasehold basis, the majority of these were under the Right To Buy (RTB) legislation. 
      The dwellings are flats in blocks and flats in houses (maisonettes) where the Contracting Authority still retain the freehold ownership and in some case the leases may state that the Contracting Authority, as the Freeholder, will arrange the buildings insurance on behalf of the Leaseholder and recharge the premium as part of the Service Charge. Other flats in some blocks have not been sold (Council tenanted) and are separately insured so insurance cover for these flats are not required. 
      
      The current Long Term Agreement expires on 31st December 2023.
      
      Cover is expected to commence at 00.01am on the 1st January 2024.

title: SCC - MS - Local Bus Routes 2024 - DDRT Surrey East
description:
This mini competition is to encompass the retendering of 1 enhanced DDRT (Digital Demand Responsive Transport) service in East Surrey.  
      
      Currently 6 services are operating in Surrey and the requirement is for Surrey to have an increased number of travel opportunities making DDRT available to a greater number of Surrey residents. 
      
      The contract is the operation of the Surrey connect DDRT bus service in the Surrey East operating area, for up to six buses and a booking call centre. Surrey connect is a digital on demand bus service, known as a Digital Demand Responsive Transport solution, that is available in Surrey which enables residents to book a convenient bus journey when they need it, up to 7 days in advance or 30 minutes before you travel. It has been rolled out to improve access to sustainable travel where fewer traditional bus services are on offer. This service can help people who may be isolated due to their location and those who have had to traditionally be heavily car dependent. 
      
      We tendered 2+1-year contracts in January 2024 via the Public Bus Dynamic Purchasing System for operators to run the services on the behalf of SCC in 4 main areas: Surrey North, Surrey Southwest, Surrey Central and Surrey East. We successfully awarded 3 of the 4 areas but are retendering Surrey East due to the bids we received being incompatible with our requirements. We have adjusted the scope to allow for diesel buses in the first year of the contract, due to the lack of charging options in Tandridge.
